comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The whole Storage Management window, Aqua: Recommendations selected while the sidebar has the keyboard focus (a click on the selected row), the four recommendations beside it. Whole crop: the text is set in the fallback font, and the glyphs of the sidebar and the four icons are plain stand-ins for Apple's artwork.

comparisons.name: window-light-layout
comparisons.description: As window-light with the text and the stand-in artwork masked: the title, the glyph and name of Recommendations, the glyphs, names and sizes of the other rows of the sidebar, the icon, title and text of each recommendation, and the button titles. Scores the frame, the title bar and its controls, the sidebar's fill, its accent selection and its two lines, the divider, the content, the lines between the recommendations and the buttons' bezels.

comparisons.name: window-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Storage Management window, Dark Aqua: the dark capture's categories and free space, Recommendations selected while the sidebar has the keyboard focus. Whole crop: fallback font, stand-in glyphs and icons.

comparisons.name: window-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As window-dark with the text and the stand-in artwork masked as in window-light-layout; the dark capture has seven categories above its second line and one row under it, so the two masks over the sidebar's rows are placed for them. Scores the frame, the title bar and its controls, the sidebar's fill, its accent selection and its two lines, the divider, the content, the lines between the recommendations and the buttons' bezels.

comparisons.name: documents-light
comparisons.description: A state no screenshot shows: a category's files, Aqua. A click on Documents in the sidebar opens its table, and a click on the first row selects that file: the table has the keyboard focus, so its selection is emphasised and the sidebar's turns grey.

pixels.note: the first file is selected and emphasised: the measured selection colour of a focused table (spec: table-view), in the Name column after the name
Documents is the selected row of a sidebar that no longer has the focus: the grey selection measured over the opaque sidebar in Finder (spec: sidebar)
Recommendations is no longer selected: the sidebar's opaque fill, measured in Finder (the capture of this window holds #e7e7e5)
the bar under the table is the content background, measured in the capture's Recommendations pane; that a category's pane has such a bar is provisional
